concept_attempts.feedback: Selected: connected lobed flared mineral base, rounded leaning head, single diagonal deep-blue channel ending at one pale-blue lens. Fine strata, socket engineering and unseen surfaces are authored. No separate legs, reactor or energy beam added.

issues: Head is too tall relative to the lower mass. Reduce its height and increase connected mineral foundation height according to original silhouette.
The thick black neck and separated low rounded roots look like a robot on paws. Bury a much thinner neck and extend the mineral buttresses up into the body.
The blue channel reads applied: seat its blue surface deeper into the actual cut groove.

final_review: Final independent GLB keeps the broad connected mineral supports, front toe, seated rounded left-leaning head, one diagonal deep-blue channel and one pale-blue lens. Actual feedback reduces the over-tall head, thick exposed neck and paw-like low roots while increasing the connected lower mass and recessing the blue surface. Used material slots are normalized before export and final native/import materials match.
limitations: Exact sections, underside, socket engineering, detailed wear and channel/lens physical purpose are authored or unknown.
Broad source shapes take priority over copying every generated mineral microcrevice. PB23/ST21 generic powerplant research supplies function context, not Mikotaj body geometry.
No source metric height, calibrated game scale/state, Android performance or final user artistic acceptance claimed.
